notes: **2026-08-23** — SALES AGENTS & COMMISSIONS UI (PR-D, branch feat/sales-agents-ui; NO migration, NO schema change): the surfaces the PR-C engine deferred. ONE deliberate API addition — `GET /sales-agents/assignments/current?customerId=` → `SalesAgentsService.currentAssignment` (open `AgentAssignment` + the customer's currently-effective `CustomerCommissionRate`), declared as a two-segment route beside `assignments/close` so it cannot collide with `:id`, inheriting the class-level flag+role guards; `customers.service.findOne` was deliberately NOT widened. Web: new `lib/api/sales-agents.ts` (all types + ~20 hooks; money/rate fields typed `number | string` because Prisma `Decimal` serializes as a JSON string), `SALES_AGENTS_ADDON = "sales_agents"` in `lib/api/addons.ts`, two nav leaves spliced into the `navStructure` memo (never `OPERATOR_NAV`), `app/(dashboard)/sales-agents/` (list + detail + AgentFormModal + AssignCustomersModal), `app/(dashboard)/finance/commissions/` (list + detail + GenerateStatementModal + RecordPayoutModal), a "Sales Agent" card on the customer detail page + an add-mode-only agent select in `CustomerFormModal`, and a staff-gated per-order `commissionRatePct` override in `CreateOrderModal` (payload spread is `!= null` so `0` = exempt is SENT) / order detail / `OrderDraftPayload`. Mobile: read-only "Sales agent" row on the operator customer screen only. **THE GATING RULE:** every query hook takes `opts?: { enabled?: boolean }` and every page passes it — a gated GET that 403s trips the `api-client.ts` PLAN_GATE toast bridge, so one un-gated hook on a shared surface (customer page, order modal) would toast every unflagged tenant on every page load; full pages additionally gate their `LockedPage` on `useTenantAddons().isLoading` to avoid a lock-flash. **Money:** STORED amounts only — `drift` renders verbatim as "Unclaimed", never recomputed; the sole client arithmetic is the display-time `total − paid` remaining in the payout modal, which the server re-derives and caps in-tx. **The stale-409 contract:** approve 409s matching `"stale"` in the MESSAGE (the body carries no machine code and adding one was out of scope) show a banner whose one click voids then re-generates with the SAME agent/period and `router.replace`s onto the fresh statement — two requests, not one tx, so a crash between them leaves a VOID statement and no replacement (ledger still clean; recovery is the normal Generate button). e2e `18-sales-agents-gate.spec.ts` (project `sales-agents-gate`) is read-only and branches on the tenant's live addon state, green in BOTH. No web Jest — web correctness rides on check-types + lint + that one spec. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
